summary: Phase 5 testing complete - All backend and frontend features tested successfully. C# client library verified, per-product Quickstart picker working, Audit page filters functional, all regression tests passed.
passed_tests: C# client library exists with WatchNexusClient class and all required methods (ActivateAsync, ValidateAsync, DeactivateAsync)
C# Program.cs example exists and uses WatchNexusClient
README.md mentions C# client with usage examples
GET /api/admin/quickstart returns products array with all products (id, name, slug, signing_method, fingerprint_mode, max_seats_default)
GET /api/admin/quickstart returns selected_product_id (defaults to first/oldest product)
GET /api/admin/quickstart?product_id=<id> selects that product and returns matching demo license
Demo license matches selected product (product_id, signing_method, fingerprint_mode all match)
Bootstrap demo license created lazily with is_bootstrap:true, source:bootstrap, plan:demo
POST /api/admin/quickstart/test with product_id runs 3-step cycle (activate→validate→deactivate)
Quickstart test response includes correct product_slug and all steps have status 200
Running quickstart test 5 times in a row succeeds (seat recycling works)
GET /api/admin/audit?actor_type=admin returns only admin events (72 events verified)
GET /api/admin/audit?action=quickstart returns only quickstart events (15 events verified)
Combined filters ?actor_type=admin&action=login returns only admin.login events (21 events verified)
Bootstrap API key works on /api/integrate/activate endpoint
POST /api/admin/quickstart/rotate-key works and returns new wnk_ prefixed key
All webhook endpoints exist (lemonsqueezy, paddle, gumroad, stripe return 401, not 404)
Product picker (quickstart-product-picker) exists on /admin/quickstart page
Product picker lists all products with signing method shown
Demo license card shows seats, signing method, and fingerprint mode in descriptive line
Selecting different product in picker updates demo license (license key changed)
Run test button (quickstart-run-test-button) executes test successfully
Test results display all 3 steps (quickstart-test-step-0/1/2) with correct data
Step 1 response includes license/product field with correct product slug
Audit page has search input (audit-search-input) for filtering by action
Audit page has actor dropdown (audit-actor-select) with options: all/admin/customer/integrator/webhook/system
All 8 quick filter chips present: license.*, activation.*, api_key.*, product.*, quickstart.*, admin.login, customer.login, email.*
Clicking quickstart.* chip filters table to show only quickstart events
Clear button (audit-filter-reset) appears when filters are active
Clear button removes all filters and disappears when no filters active
Search input filtering works with debounce (tested with 'license' search)
Actor dropdown filtering works (tested with 'admin' selection)
Empty state (audit-empty-state-filtered) shown for non-matching search with Clear filters button
All regression pages load without errors: Dashboard, Licenses, Products, API Keys, Builds, Webhooks, Customers
